title: God, Who Is Just and Kind
description: God, Who Is Just and Kind in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Patrick wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 496 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Fatherly Love of God”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: God, who is just and kind, Will those who err in-struct, And to the paths of right-eous-ness Their wan-dering steps con-duct.

lines: God, who is just and kind,
And to the paths of righteousness
Kindness and truth he shows to all
And lead me through whatever path
Nor suffer the fair hope to fail,
Which on thy truth is built.

licence: Public domain: John Patrick died in 1695.
credits: Words by John Patrick (1632–1695), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
